home.hero_subtitle:
Former NGO project manager, now trained at École 42 Paris

Full-Stack Developer, I design end-to-end web solutions, from Back-end architecture to modern Front-end interfaces
home.availability: 📅 Immediately available for a Full-Stack Developer position
home.intro_1: After completing the curriculum at École 42 Paris, I strengthened my skills at Japan Awaits by leading the redesign of a complex business application.
home.intro_2: 🛠️ In my previous NGO roles, I gained solid experience in project and financial management.
home.intro_3: 💡 My goal is to merge these organizational skills with my technical expertise to create innovative and effective solutions.
home.intro_4: 🌍 I am passionate about the positive impact technology can have on society and am determined to contribute to projects that make a real difference.
home.intro_5: My objective is to put my technical versatility and rigor at the service of collaborative projects, by designing high-performance and user-centric applications.
